title: Morganic's WineSMP QOL Mod
description: This mod adds new crafting recipes, blocks and items using steel.
body:
🍷 Morganic’s WineSMP QOL Mod (Forge 1.19.2)

A custom Quality of Life mod made for my friend's WineSMP, designed to make survival more interesting, more efficient, and just a bit more chaotic—in the best way.

Built for Minecraft Forge 1.19.2, this mod adds new materials, a new machine, crafting options, and a mysterious surprise to spice up your world.

⚙️ Main Features

🪨 Steel Progression System
Turn basic resources into something stronger. This mod introduces:

Steel Ingots

Steel Nuggets

Steel Blocks
Advance beyond iron and start your journey into the Steel Age.

🧱 The Compresser Machine
A custom utility block that lets you compress materials into more useful forms. Simple to use, powerful in survival, and perfect for resource management.

🧪 Custom Crafting Recipes
Struggling to find certain materials? This mod adds alternate ways to craft things like:

Copper ingots

Gold ingots

Gunpowder
Giving you more flexibility without completely breaking survival balance.

🧍 Training Dummies

Need something to test your weapons on?
This mod adds:

Dummy: Basically just a mannequin.

Living Dummy: The same thing except it can walk.

Perfect for combat practice, traps, or just decorating your base with something slightly unsettling.

🧠 The Brain Item

Used for crafting the Living Dummy because how else would it be able to move?

🏛️ Secrets in the World…

Legends say a mysterious structure may generate somewhere in your world. If you find it… you might not be alone.

This mod also has JEI built into it and requires no dependency mods.
🎯 Designed For

✔️ Survival Multiplayer
✔️ Small Servers
✔️ Friends who want vanilla-plus gameplay
✔️ Players who like progression without heavy tech mods

This mod was originally made for a private SMP, but now you can use it in your own worlds too. Simple additions, useful mechanics, and just enough mystery to keep things interesting.

Have fun.
